senses.gloss: (denom. of גַּרְמָא, cmp. עצם) to be substantial, strong. *Targ. Prov. XVIII, 10 וניגריס ביה Ms. a. Var. in ed. Lag. (read ונִיגְרִים; ed. ונתרים).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 5:19">Ib. V, 19</cite> <cite ref="V00092"><he>תִּגְרַם</he></cite> (some ed. <he>תְּגָרֵם</he>, Ms. <he>תגרס</he>) thou shalt grow strong.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 35:9">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XXXV, 9</cite> <he>וגָרִימַת וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>וגְרִי׳</he> Pe.) and Thou didst strengthen him (in his trouble).

senses.gloss: to eat up to the bone, to pick off.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 27:2">Targ. Ps. XXVII, 2</cite> <he>לְגָּרָמָא</he> (Ms. a. Regia <he>לגַמָּרָא</he>, v. <cite ref="C01065"><he>גְּמַר</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 22a:9">B. Bath. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>אדמְגַרְמִיתוּ גרמי וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>מגרדיתו</he> fr. <cite ref="C01269"><he>גְּרַד</he></cite>; Ar. <he>דמגריסתו</he> fr. <cite ref="C01374"><he>גְּרַס</he></cite>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) in place of picking off bones (receiving scanty instruction) in the school of A., go ye and eat flesh &c.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 8:28">Targ. Prov. VIII, 28</cite> (Var. <he>אוגריס</he>, h. text <cite ref="A02055"><he>אמץ</he></cite>).
